newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Two Iranians sentenced to death in Kuwait.
newsitem.headline: Two Iranians sentenced to death in Kuwait.

text.p: Two Iranians were sentenced to death in Kuwait for the first time since drug smuggling was made a capital crime in 1995, a newspaper reported on Sunday.
Al-Seyassah said an appeals court confirmed an earlier ruling by a criminal court sentencing the two to death and a fine of 100,000 dinars ($330,000).
Death sentences require ratification by a cassation court and the country's Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad-Sabah.
Kuwait hangs criminals sentenced to death.
